home.metaTitle: Kuulis · Motorbike rides, no commission per ride
home.metaDescription: Get a motorbike ride in minutes and pay the driver directly, however you agree. Drivers pay no commission per ride, just a small monthly fee in the months they work.

hero.title: Across Caracas by motorbike. Full stop.
hero.lead: See the fare in dollars and bolívares before you book, know exactly who's coming to pick you up, and pay your driver directly, however you both prefer.
hero.photoAlt: A Caracas highway at night, lit by passing cars.

price.title: You know the price before you get on.
price.body: The app works out the fare from distance and time and shows it in dollars, alongside the bolívar amount at both the BCV and Binance rates. That's the price, for you and for your driver.

rates.title: Dollars and bolívares
rates.body: Both rates on screen, so nobody has to do the maths on the street.

pay.title: Pay however you agree
pay.body: You pay your driver directly, with the method you agree on:

haggle.title: No haggling
haggle.body: The app sets the price, not an argument.

price.binance: In Bs at the Binance rate
price.exampleNote: Example from the app on October 17, 2026: from Mohedano to the Sambil mall. The price depends on distance and time, and the rates change every day.

drivers.title: Kuulis takes 0% of every ride.
drivers.body: Every dollar your rider pays is yours. You pay a monthly fee based on what you earned, capped at {max}, and nothing in months you don't drive. Your first {months} months are free.
drivers.bodyNoMax: Every dollar your rider pays is yours. You pay a small monthly fee based on what you earned, and nothing in months you don't drive. Your first {months} months are free.

stop3.title: Arrive and pay

commission.q: Does Kuulis take a commission on each ride?
commission.a: No. The rider pays the full fare to the driver. Drivers pay a monthly fee based on what they earned, and nothing in months they didn't drive.

pay.q: How do I pay for the ride?
pay.a: Directly to your driver: cash, pago móvil, Zelle or Binance, whatever you agree on. The app sets the price, and it is the same for both of you.

store.q: Why isn't it on the Play Store?
store.a: For now the app is installed from this site. The Download page shows you how to do it safely.

iphone.q: I have an iPhone. Can I use Kuulis?
iphone.a: Not yet. Kuulis is Android-only for now; we'll announce an iPhone version here when it's ready.

driver.q: What do I need to drive?
driver.a: Be at least {age}, have a {year} or newer motorbike with its papers, and upload your documents in the app. We review your application and let you know.
driver.aNoData: Have your motorbike with its papers and upload your documents in the app. We review your application and let you know.

final.title: Install it once. Ride whenever you need.
final.body: You download Kuulis from this site, not from the Play Store. We'll walk you through it and show you how to check the file really comes from us.

safety.title: You know who's driving you. So does someone you trust.

verified.title: Verified drivers
verified.body: We check their ID, license, medical certificate and bike papers before they can go online.

pin.title: Start PIN
pin.body: In {cities}, the ride doesn't start until you give your driver your PIN.

live.title: Live trip
live.body: Share a link so the people you trust can follow the ride on a map until you arrive.

sos.title: SOS button
sos.body: Press and hold it to call {number}, then send your live location to your trusted contacts.

step1.title: Say where you're going
step1.body: Type the destination: a street, a building, a mall. The app already knows where you are.

step2.title: See the price before you book
step2.body: In dollars, and in bolívares at the BCV and Binance rates. That price is the same for you and your driver.

step3.title: Pay your driver directly
step3.body: Cash, pago móvil, Zelle or Binance, however you agree. Kuulis takes nothing from the ride.

drivers.metaTitle: Drive with Kuulis · No commission per ride
drivers.metaDescription: What you earn is yours: Kuulis charges no commission per ride. Requirements, the monthly fee with an example, and how to sign up.
drivers.title: What you earn is yours.
drivers.lead: Kuulis charges no commission per ride. You bring the bike and the hours; we bring you the rides.

commission.title: Zero commission
commission.body: We take nothing from your rides. The rider pays you directly, however you agree.

free.title: {months} months free from your first ride
free.body: Start without paying anything. Then a small fee only in the months you work.

direct.title: You decide when you go online
direct.body: Go online whenever you want and get rides near you.

requirements.title: What you need.
requirements.phone: An Android phone with data and GPS
requirements.review: We review your documents before you can go online.

fees.title: Your fee, in numbers.
fees.body: The fee is based on what you earned in the month.
fees.bodyNoData: The fee is small and based on what you earned in the month. See the current table in the app.
fees.example: Example: earn {earned} in a month and you pay {fee}. You keep {rest}.
fees.exampleFree: Example: earn {earned} in a month and you pay nothing.
fees.note: Paid from your Kuulis wallet. No rides in a month, nothing to pay. The first {months} months are free.

steps.title: How to sign up.
steps.step1: Download the app and create your account.
steps.step2: In Profile, switch to driver mode and fill in your application.
steps.step3: Upload your documents and the photos of your bike.
steps.step4: We review your application and let you know when you can go online.

free.q: When do the free months start?
free.a: From your first completed ride, not from when you sign up. You get {months} months.

idle.q: What if I don't work for a month?
idle.a: You pay nothing. The fee is only charged in months when you have rides.

paid.q: How do I get paid for rides?
paid.a: The rider pays you directly, with whatever method you agree on. Kuulis keeps none of it.

fee.q: How do I pay the fee?
fee.a: From your Kuulis wallet. If your balance falls short, the fee stays pending and is charged when you top up.

final.title: Your bike, your hours, your money.
final.body: Download the app, switch to driver mode in your profile and send your application. We'll let you know when it's approved.

safety.metaTitle: Safety at Kuulis · Before, during and after the ride
safety.metaDescription: Verified drivers, a start PIN, live trip sharing, an SOS button and ratings. What the Kuulis app does so you can ride with peace of mind.
safety.title: Feeling safe is part of the ride.
safety.lead: This is what the app does before, during and after every ride. We only list what already works.

verified.title: Verified drivers
verified.body: We review their documents and their bike before they can go online. No approval, no rides.

identity.title: You know who's coming
identity.body: You see their name, photo, rating and bike: make, model, color and plate.

pin.title: Start PIN
pin.body: In {cities}, the ride doesn't start until you give the driver your PIN.

live.title: Live trip
live.body: Share a link and your people follow the ride on the map until you arrive. If you save trusted contacts, the app offers to tell them as soon as a driver is assigned.

chat.title: In-app chat
chat.body: You talk to the driver through the ride's chat.

other.title: Ride for someone else
other.body: If the ride is for someone else, you send them their own link, with the ride's PIN when it applies.

checkin.title: All good?
checkin.body: If the ride stops for a long time or leaves the route, the app asks both of you whether everything is fine.

sos.title: SOS button
sos.body: Hold it down and the app calls {number}. Then you send your live location to your trusted contacts, one tap each.

report.title: Report a problem
report.body: From your ride history you report a problem or a lost item, and we ask the driver.

rating.title: Ratings both ways
rating.body: When the ride ends, you rate the driver and the driver rates you.

community.title: Community guidelines
community.body: The same rules for riders and drivers.

safety.pinCaption: Example: every ride gets its own PIN.
safety.notice: Kuulis doesn't replace emergency services. If you're in danger, call {number}.

final.title: Ride with someone who knows where you are.
final.body: Download the app, save your trusted contacts and book your first ride.
